column4: result directory; leave empty to write to cases/<case_name> (a value here overrides case_name)
plane=flat ground; slope=single slope; terrain=compound terrain (cones of terrain_radius/height/density); dem=DEM facet ensemble (multi-ridge terrain; requires dem_file); urban=buildings and streets
equivalent terrain radius m; semicolon-separated for multiple layers
equivalent terrain height m; semicolon-separated for multiple layers
terrain spatial density; semicolon-separated for multiple layers
ESRI ASCII grid (.asc) for surface_model=dem or ridge; path relative to input.csv
slope class width degrees for the facet ensemble
aspect class width degrees for the facet ensemble
1=cast shadows by horizon ray march; 0=no cast shadow
building plan density; semicolon-separated for multiple shapes

thermal multiple scattering: empty=radiosity with canopy_closure=standard (same street + four-wall radiosity as the optics) or legacy otherwise; legacy=single-bounce exchange; radiosity=street + four-wall radiosity (all orders; one building class)
vegetation height m (TIRTEB aerodynamics); run.py uses it only with canopy_closure=legacy as the optical crown vertical semiaxis (standard/upgrade use crown_rad_b)
hotspot parameter = leaf size / canopy height; for crowns use leaf size / crown height

standard=CI transmittance + dual-scale hotspot (two-layer + compensation) + node radiosity; upgrade=exact geometric optics (K-integral hom / row cross-section / FRT-type crowns) + the same node radiosity; both apply to hom/row/crown on plane/slope/terrain/urban in thermal and optical bands; legacy=earlier closures (thermal_*_geometry and optical methods below apply only with legacy)
leaf width m (TIRTEB only; not used by run.py)
parametric=closed-form row cross-section (standard); conditioned_corridor or legacy=earlier closures

plane rows; empty=standard model; legacy=CI transmittance + CI layer hotspot + equivalent-homogeneous scattering; conditioned=legacy + hotspot correlation compensation; reference=parametric geometry + cross-section radiosity (thermal and shortwave)
crown base height above ground m (sets the crown-centre height of the parametric crowns)
parametric=closed-form Poisson spheroid crowns (standard); clumping_dual or legacy=earlier closures
terrain forests: legacy=terrain interreflection + canopy scatter (standard); reciprocal_exchange=4-state exchange (requires canopy_closure=legacy)

terrain crown method with canopy_closure=legacy: reciprocal_exchange (default; 4-state project closure) or facet_exchange (explicit facets); with canopy_closure=standard or upgrade terrain forests use the standard terrain closure and this key is ignored (except effective_slab)
direct=use the six rows below; file=read spectrals_file (7 rows in the same order)
band centres um; <2.5 um gives BRF and >=2.5 um gives brightness temperature
leaf transmittance per band; thermal leaf emissivity = 1 - reflectance - transmittance
soil (and terrain facet) reflectance per band; thermal emissivity = 1 - reflectance
street reflectance per band; thermal emissivity = 1 - reflectance
wall reflectance per band; thermal emissivity = 1 - reflectance
roof reflectance per band; thermal emissivity = 1 - reflectance
0=use soil emissivity directly; 1=use Hapke directional correction
equivalent 8-14 um sky brightness temperature K (default 250 = typical clear sky); adds (1-emissivity) x B(T_sky); none = black sky (emission only; HiSTREAM validation setting)

0=given vza/vaa lists; 1=solar principal and perpendicular planes; 2=read geometry_file TXT; 3=both principal planes from principal_vza_step/principal_vza_max plus optional hemisphere/file/manual directions
legacy alias when geometry_mode is omitted: direct or file
vza vaa or vza vaa sza saa per line
cross=cartesian product; zip=pair lists by row
view zenith interval degrees for mode 3 and for mode 1 when principal_vza is empty
maximum view zenith degrees for mode 3 and for mode 1 when principal_vza is empty
